Please find that email in your inbox, then send a warning right away to both Sara Lee and Michael Smith (sara.lee@bluesparrowtech.com and michael.smith@bluesparrowtech.com). 'Urgent: the London AI Summit Registration Confirmation from events@london-ai-summit.org is fraudulent and should not be trusted.'

Let me know once it's out.
Mark
